statements.t: MINNEAPOLIS, NOVEMBER 6, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — OneMedNet Corporation (Nasdaq: ONMD) (“OneMedNet,” the “Company,” “we,” “us” or “our”), a leading provider of First-Party (Direct-from-Source) regulatory decision-grade, AI-driven Real-World Data (RWD), today announced preliminary revenue results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provides revenue guidance for the fourth quarter of 2026.

The Company expects to report revenue of approximately $1 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, representing a 242% increase from the prior quarter ended June 30, 2026, and a 465% increase from the prior-year quarter ended September 30, 2025.
The Company also forecasts revenue of approximately $12 million to $14 million for the fourth quarter of 2026, pending the anticipated acceptance of delivered data by customers.

Our anticipated revenue pace in the fourth quarter of 2026 is expected for two reasons: our data coming direct from our healthcare provider partners, and our building of our de-identification pipeline and delivery infrastructure to scale with demand.

Third quarter 2026 revenue results are preliminary and are subject to finalization and adjustment in connection with the preparation of the Company’s Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, which we expect to release by November 16, 2026.

These statements include, but are not limited to, statements regarding our preliminary results for third of 2026, our revenue outlook for the fourth quarter of 2026, the timing of revenue recognition, the anticipation of data delivery and customer acceptance, and statements generally about our products, plans and strategies.
